written.label: What we say
written.summary: Pre-seed and seed in India, often the first institutional cheque of $100K to $500K. Fintech, deeptech, consumer tech and consumer brands. Founder-market fit and why now. We avoid later stages, overpriced entries and pedigree-only bets.

rules.text: The founder owns the hardest risk.
Consumer brands are judged on cohort repeat and margin fluency.
A missing number lowers the score.
The business must fit a pre-seed cheque's structure.
No company whose existence depends on a favourable regulatory change.
Defensiveness on weak spots is information.
Founder behaviour beats the sector label.
